name: iOS app fetching shared SQLite database

mentions.name: iOS app fetching shared SQLite database
mentions.description: This iOS app fetches the shared SQLite database from the same CDN location used by the author's Django site. It was vibe coded and found surprisingly simple, much simpler than using Flutter or React Native.
mentions.source_excerpt: I vibe coded a iOS app using that same SQLite database that fetches it from the same location. It was surprisingly simple. It seems much simpler than using Flutter or React native.
